dataset.description:
The data set contains the example of reverse Monte Carlo (RMC) simulation of EXAFS spectra collected for fcc high-entropy alloy AuCuNiPdPt at 273 K.

The simulation was performed by the EvAX code freely available from http://www.dragon.lv/evax/.

distribution.title: Dataset provides an example of reverse Monte Carlo simulation for fcc high-entropy alloy AuCuNiPdPt at 273 K. It can be used as a template for multi-edge EXAFS data analysis.
